description: Machine-checkable denylist proving the compliance floor (compliance-floor-v1) is unreachable through the Private Apps contract. These scope ids are not part of the V1 catalog, must be rejected if requested in a tot-app.json manifest, and have no corresponding endpoint in openapi.yaml or topic in asyncapi.yaml. Every forbiddenScopes entry maps to one enumerated clause of floor.statement through its floorRef; Content-Security-Policy has no scope at all because no scope can add, weaken, or bypass it.

floor.statement: Private apps can NEVER disable, replace, mutate, or bypass: age/identity verification; excise/tax enforcement; jurisdiction rules/eligibility; required legal/FDA/age/state/shipping warnings and their placement; Content-Security-Policy; promotion/publish (go-live) gates; signed-cart payloads; checkout totals/validity; PII minimization (no unrestricted access to customer PII or age/identity evidence). Apps get scoped, least-privilege, mostly-READ access, never write access to these surfaces, never DOM/cookie/checkout access.

forbiddenScopes.forbids: Any mutation of checkout totals, line pricing, cart contents, or checkout validity.
forbiddenScopes.reason: Checkout totals/validity are platform-owned and signed; a mutating app could change what a customer is charged.

forbiddenScopes.forbids: Any change to excise/sales tax computation, rates, or collected amounts.
forbiddenScopes.reason: Excise/tax enforcement is legally mandated and platform-computed; apps must never alter it.

forbiddenScopes.forbids: Any change to age/identity verification state, result, or the requirement to verify.
forbiddenScopes.reason: Age/identity verification gates regulated sales; an app must never set, clear, or bypass it.

forbiddenScopes.forbids: Any change to required legal/FDA/age/state/shipping warning copy or its placement.
forbiddenScopes.reason: Warning copy and placement are source-required and legally binding; apps may not rewrite, hide, or reposition them.
forbiddenScopes.floorRef: required legal/FDA/age/state/shipping warnings and their placement

forbiddenScopes.forbids: Approving, overriding, or expanding jurisdiction eligibility for a sale or shipment.
forbiddenScopes.reason: Jurisdiction rules/eligibility determine where a product may lawfully ship; only the platform decides.

forbiddenScopes.forbids: Creating, altering, or re-signing signed-cart payloads.
forbiddenScopes.reason: Signed carts are the integrity boundary between storefront and checkout; forging them breaks trust in the price/contents.

forbiddenScopes.forbids: Triggering or bypassing the promotion/publish (go-live) gate to push tenant changes live.
forbiddenScopes.reason: Go-live is evidence-gated and platform-owned; an app must not publish or skip the promote gate.

forbiddenScopes.forbids: Bulk or unrestricted access to customer PII (raw email/name/address, age/identity evidence, verification documents).
forbiddenScopes.reason: PII is minimized by scope; unrestricted access defeats data-minimization and exposes regulated identity evidence.
forbiddenScopes.floorRef: PII minimization (no unrestricted access to customer PII or age/identity evidence)

csp.note: Content-Security-Policy is a floor surface with NO scope at all — forbidden or otherwise. Widgets render only through the existing platform-owned sandbox (allow-scripts, no allow-same-origin) and CSP-hash pinning; there is no contract path that lets an app add, weaken, or bypass CSP. Listed here so the floor's CSP clause is explicitly accounted for.
